messages:
zoe: Heads-up onboarding BluePeak LoRA (bluepeak-lora@1.0) into staging. Plan: tokenizer remap, small behavioral pack, and an experimental int3 probe. Tagging @marco for quant ops.

marco: Int3 is aggressive. Recommend baseline + int4 calibrated before int3. If we run int3, do perchannel+symm calib and isolate long-contexts.

zoe: Running token diff first. Cmd: python tools/token_check.py --base open-7b --adapter bluepeak-lora --out /tmp/bp-map.json

eval-bot: token diff complete: remapped=4, oov=2 (ORDR, INV#). Artifact: gs://redwood-evals/bluepeak/tokenmap.json

tess: Those two OOVs look like formatting variants. Can we remap ORDR->ORDER and INV#->INVOICE# before quant runs?

zoe: Patched remap and reuploaded adapter. Queued baseline (adapter, no quant) job=job_100125. metadata=model=bluepeak-lora@1.0, base=open-7b@2026-03-18, seed=7

eval-bot: baseline finished: money-f1=0.98, numeric-mape=0.9%, p50lat +5ms. Artifacts: http://ci.internal/reports/bluepeak/100125/base.html

marco: Good. Launch int4-calibrated (perchannel, calib=2048) and an int3-probe (perchannel, calib=4096) but run long-thread subset with cache disabled.

eval-bot: int4-calib results: money-f1=0.95, numeric-mape=1.4%. int3-probe results: money-f1=0.82, numeric-mape=4.7% — decimal/magnitude collapse on small-value cases. Full: http://ci.internal/reports/bluepeak/100125/quant.html

zoe: Top failing example: Prompt: "10 items at $0.10 each" baseline: "USD 1.00" int3: "USD 0.1" (magnitude dropped). Repro steps included in artifact.

tess: Sounds like scale quant noise amplified by soft-prompt. Recommend per-layer bias correction or serving int4-calibrated for numeric-sensitive customers. Add routing tag bluepeak-numeric-safe -> int4-calib.

marco: Agreed. Also file ENG-ML-4502 with failing prompts for adapter author; soft-prompt scaling looks suspicious.

zoe: Done: route created, ticket opened, artifacts archived gs://redwood-artifacts/bluepeak/job_100125.tar.gz. Will hold int3 as experimental; promote int4-calib for production-sensitive flows. Closing loop after a short bakeout. :thumbsup:
